correctness.rationale: Exact four-history probabilities yield all three Fisher entries and determinant by direct differentiation; the chosen design maximizes f(x)+f(theta-x). Uniform C² expansion proves strict small-budget equality, an exact rational witness proves loss of global equal-budget optimality, and compactness plus unique maximizer of f prove every long-budget maximizing short gap converges. The packaged independent symbolic and rational checker replayed 1214 assertions.

value.rationale: Joint estimation of ecological occupancy and detection intensity motivates two binary visits. The theorem reveals unexpected parameter-independent design geometry and an explicit finite unequal-effort advantage, with an exponentially growing long-budget information advantage. It provides a natural theoretical design benchmark rather than an arbitrary parameter slice; practical limits are explicit.
